import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('evaluator','evals/evaluate.py')
e=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(e)
cases=e.load_cases(Path('evals/cases.jsonl'))
criteria={c['id']:(case['id'],c) for case in cases for c in case['criteria']}
root=Path('evals/baseline/2026-09-20-original').resolve()
attempts,warnings=e.discover_attempts(root,{c['id'] for c in cases})
reviews=e.load_reviews(Path('evals/reviews/2026-09-20-maintainer-semantic.jsonl'),criteria)
rows,groups=e.score_all(cases,attempts,reviews,root)
summary=e.summarize(cases,rows,groups,e.result_kinds(root,groups),warnings)
assert len(rows)==48 and len(reviews)==14
print(json.dumps({'scores':rows,'summary':summary}))
